correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all distinct zero-sum column triples: either all three lie in one spread member with zero label or three different members whose labels sum to zero. The full-spread direct-sum property gives one pair per eligible member pair, and target-plus-helper uniqueness proves automatic disjointness. Exact index-label enumeration gives all 17 local counts and 33 cross-member triples, 4 internal zero-label members, and 635 weight-three dual words. An independent full binary code enumeration over 4096 words and Walsh/character-sum proof both confirm rank 12 and distance 60. The script explicitly constructs and checks the Desarguesian example; the written proof, not brute force, establishes universality over all full four-spreads.

originality.rationale: The novel assertion is the exact all-symbol disjoint two-helper repair spectrum for the four-index-set, length-255 binary spread code and its spread-independent label theorem. The 2026 source supplies the code but no such spectrum; other inspected partial-spread LRCs use different parity-check generators. Overall dual weight-three multiplicity does not determine its coordinatewise distribution. Searches cannot guarantee priority, and a previously unknown computation remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: A prior unstated or unindexed calculation of the exact per-coordinate dual-weight-three spectrum could exist; negative literature searches are not a proof of global priority.
The primary article states a different distance for its own printed example; only the printed index sets and first-principles arithmetic were used here, not its unsupported numerical distance.
The formula for arbitrary spread labels is elementary once the column model is isolated; any older fully general generator-label theorem discovered later would cover it.

value.rationale: For the very same 255-coordinate code, the full multiplicity profile of independent two-symbol repair alternatives is a natural storage-reliability invariant, exposing a twelve-versus-three disparity masked by total counts. The spread-independent formula makes the profile usable across constructions, while the independently established distance 60 corrects an apparent coding-performance parameter of the printed example. Neither a parameter change alone nor the global dual A3 count is relied on to justify value.
